topics.title: Write a paragraph about helping a neighbour in need.
guiding_questions: Who is the person you want to help?
What problem does this person have?
What idea can you think of to help him/her?
What tools or people do you need?
topics.sample_essay: My neighbour, Ahmed, is a boy who cannot walk. He watches us play sadly every day. I have an initiative to help him. I will provide a wheelchair and ask my friends to include him in our games. Helping him will make him happy and feel part of our group. Truly, small initiatives change lives.

topics.title: Write a paragraph about a personal initiative to help your community.
guiding_questions: Why did you choose this initiative?
topics.sample_essay: My initiative is to help visually impaired students in my school. I have decided to record their books in mp3 format. I will provide free recordings on a YouTube channel. My friends have volunteered to help with the montage. I chose this because students need support. Light Initiative taught me anyone can make a difference.
